observation.command:
PW='PLEUTQQVHW7G3ED+C7PN%%LK'
CSRF=$(curl -s -c /tmp/lc.txt http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl | grep -oE 'name="CSRFToken" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
echo "csrf=$CSRF"
curl -s -i -b /tmp/lc.txt -c /tmp/lc.txt -X POST http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl \
  --data-urlencode "Step=Login" --data-urlencode "Language=en" --data-urlencode "AccountType=agent" \
  --data-urlencode "Login=admin" --data-urlencode "Password=$PW" --data-urlencode "CSRFToken=$CSRF" --data-urlencode "ReturnLocation=" | head -30
